ract. BG should be valid up to 60 days beyond the entire contractual obligation (Total 41 months (from effective date of Supply Order) - 03 months of delivery period + 36 month s of Warranty Period + 60 days) . It is to be noted that non-submission of BG/FDR, within 15 working days from the effective date of supply order, may lead to cancellation of supply order/contract without any prior notice. Warranty: 36 months from the date of acceptance of Stores at Buyer's premises. Delivery Period:- 90 days from the date of GeM Contract/Sanction Order. Training & Demonstration: Training & Demonstration of New modules is required for 5 days for 10 Persons at DEBEL. Payment terms: 100% payment will be made within 30 days by Competent Paying Authority after receip t and acceptance of STORES in good condition at Buyer premises. It is to be noted that the successful bidd er needs to upload necessary documents such as invoice on GeM Portal, in order to process the bill for pay ment. OEM Authorization certificate: OEM Authorization certificate from OEM should be submitted along with the technical bid by resellers. No third party OEM Authorization shall be accepted. Non-submission of OEM Authorization will lead to summary rejection of the bid. Buyer may at their discretion verify the genuinenes s of authorization certificate from the OEM, if felt necessary. Bid Security Declaration in lieu of EMD- While uploading the technical documents on GeM portal, it is r equested to participant to furnish bid security declaration in lieu of EMD. The specimen copy of the same is enclosed as ATC document. It is to be noted that in case Bid security declaration is not received on “tender bid opening date and time”, bid of such participants will summarily be rejected. Local Content: Only bidders with local content more than 20% (Cl ass II & Class I suppliers) are eligible to participate in the bid. All prospective participants are requested to kindly furnish the percentage of local c ontent & address of Value Addition as enclosed format in ATC document. It is to be noted that non-submiss ion of the local content certificate will lead to the disqualification of the particular bid. In this regard a certi ficate has to be submitted by the bidder. The Specimen copy of the same is enclosed at ATC. Restriction of participation from bidders from a country sharing land border with India : Bidders are required to provide a certificate as per the provision of Govt. Public procurement Order N o. F.No.6/18/ 2019-PPD dated 23/7/2020, as amended. The format of the certificate is enclosed at ATC. Considering this tender enabled with two packets (separately for technical bid and price bid), submission o f price bid along with technical bid is strictly prohibited and such bids shall be summarily rejected . 7.
